name: pump_curve_similarity
title: Centrifugal pump from manufacturer curves and similarity laws
summary: Pump sized from catalogue characteristic curves (flow rate, head, isentropic efficiency, required NPSH at a rated speed) and scaled to any speed with the affinity laws; the three operating modes of the original component (P_N: flow rate from pressures and speed, P_M: speed from pressures and flow rate, M_N: discharge pressure from flow rate and speed) are shipped as three files. Translation of the LaboThapPy component PumpCurveSimilarity.

verification.reference: LaboThapPy component PumpCurveSimilarity (commit f03f7f47) re-run in a throw-away venv (pip install of the local clone, Python 3.12, CoolProp 8.0.0, SciPy 1.18) on the CO2 case of pump_curve_similarity_example.py: mode P_N with the example inputs, modes P_M and M_N at the operating point found by P_N; plus an affinity-law self-check at N_rot_rated/2 and 2*N_rot_rated
verification.notes: All common variables agree within 1.13e-09 against a reference run that uses the plain HEOS property backend (the CoolSolve one). Against the default LaboThapPy run, whose MassConnector evaluates properties with BICUBIC&HEOS (spline tables), the largest difference is 7.2e-03 (W_dot_shaft), 6.8e-03 (m_dot), 4.1e-03 (V_dot), 1.7e-02 (NPSH_r): rho_su 871.60 vs 869.22 kg/m3 (0.27 %) at the same (T,P) propagates through Delta_H = DeltaP/(g*rho). Same EOS, bicubic approximation. The three modes return the same operating point (P_M recovers N_rot = 2900 rpm to 5.8e-15, M_N recovers P_ex to 1.3e-12) and the affinity laws Q~N, H~N^2 are exact (flow rate at half/double speed to 4e-10). LaboThapPy fluid name CO2 maps to EES R744 (bare CO2 is the ideal-gas species in EES).

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the LaboThapPy PumpCurveSimilarity component, three modes; verified against the component re-run in a throw-away venv)
